title: The Deep Sea Diver
content: Earlier this month, the gargantuan marionettes returned to Nantes in western France, this time with a deep sea diver (Le Scaphandrier) in search of his gigantic niece.In the second half of this video you can see how the operators lunge off the moving platform to lift the legs for each step.The spectacle was produced by the street theater company Royal de Luxe of Nantes, who brought us theSultan’s Elephant.--------Image from Flickr user misterstfPrevious GurneyJourney post on the Sultan's Elephant,link.Report on BoingBoing,link.More Flickr images of the Giant Diver,link.Wikipedia on Royal de Luxe,link.Nantes municipal website with pictures and info,link.
